test_title: PYST 50: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate idiom to fill in the blank. All my efforts went in vain.**

The project on which I was working for the last two months has failed and we are _________.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'back to square one'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate idiom to fill in the blank is **"back to square one."** This idiom means to return to the beginning or to start over again, often because previous efforts
